text: Pinned-runtime diagnostics identify premature collection returns: at least 1152 counted allocation misses followed Heap_Collect calls with collected=0 and unchanged collection epoch. These trigger one-block expansions; sweeps recover most blocks. Candidate replaces the early return on lost Synchronizer_acquire with a cooperative retry loop in an isolated runtime JAR. 120 s causal test underway; shared caches and Sirin defaults unchanged.
